reviews.x: I love these tips! There's plenty of sizes that can fit each finger and they're sturdy enough but they won't break easily. I use mine with a dip powder and get the clear version.
Ive been having a good experience with these tips, no sizing problems personally. they fit well and dont break easily. I like them.

I ordered these to try for Guitar Finger picking and they are a little to thin and break easily. Update; I apologize for the rating.  I use the acrylic nails for finger picking on my guitar.  I wanted to try the clear nails because I am a man and wanted them to look natural.  The nails were inexpensive and looked natural but for some reason they would not hold up and split after a couple of days.  The nails if used as designed were excellent for the price. I did not request a refund however PeBe

reviews.t: Okay, but not as durable as I thought...
reviews.x: Since I play fingerstyle guitar, I'm always having problems keeping my natural nails from chipping/breaking.  I don't particularly like artificial nails that cover the entire nail, since they tend to damage my natural nails over time.  I started using these nail tips and they seem to work pretty well, although I thought they would be more durable, but they tend to last for about a week or less depending on how often I play guitar.

reviews.t: Durable, bendable and easy to cut
reviews.x: They work really well with dip powder. I haven't tried with acrylic or builder gel. But, dip powder is perfect with these. They are bendable to the point they do not break. Also, they are easy to cut and file to make a coffin shape. These are pretty quare. The only con I would say, is that I wish they already came shaped so it's less work on me. Otherwise, great tips.

reviews.t: First pack was defective. Second much better.
reviews.x: The first pack i got cracked and chipped. The contacted me quickly and sent a new package that was much better!  Much happier with them now.  This were terribly cheap tips.  Shaping them caused hairline cracks throughout all tips.  Defeats the purpose of clear tips.  If your using them with an opaque acrylic like white they are fine

Really great product. Looks just like the picture and easy to use. They lasted about a week on my nails before they started to break off but easy fix with nail glue. I didn't use them with acrylics though, I just glued them onto my nail as they were and filed them down to my liking!

Five stars for sizes! I have oddly shaped nails and all uneven, I was able to match a size to every finger. The clear ones are okay, I glued, cut, and filed them and 3 days later they started to crack down the middle. I was definitely being rough with them. But they looked great!

Application was smooth, filing, good......cutting....the tips develop these hairline cracks and also you see the bending of the plastic.  I am still in search of a crystal clear tip for ballerina and stiletto nails.

reviews.t: Nothing New: I Still Love Them
reviews.x: They are very sturdy and fit the nails perfectly with little to no customizations needed. They are clear and come in little bags when you order them. If you would like a box I suggest you go to Micheals or Walmart.

reviews.t: were a little shorter than I expected but not bad quality whatsoever
reviews.x: Came on time, worth the price, were a little shorter than I expected but not bad quality whatsoever. I recommend.
Very thin and easily cracked... Not a quality product at all

reviews.t: I'm not sure it's the best

They look to be pressure cracks or something. I am hopeful that the product I am applying will hold this together. Has anyone else had this issue??

I chose more tips and still havent recieved them and that was months ago. Thats the only reason they get three stars...

I am an at home nail tech and people request coffin ALL THE TIME so these “pre-shapped” tips save me loads of filing time. They come out looking great! I attached pictures of a set I did on myself. These are actually the only nail tips I faithfully buy for my clients. WILL ORDER AGAIN.

I ordered these and another set that got here first. I wish now I would have waited... The others were flimsy compared to these. I have not used them so may amend when I do but the thickness is perfect, I have played with a couple and was pleasantly surprised. thank you,

This product was delivered very quickly and is exactly as stated.  I have not had a chance to use them yet, but I can tell by looking at them, they will be exactly what I was wanting.  I will certainly reorder this product when the time comes that I need it.

reviews.t: The tips are surprisingly very sturdy. They aren't flimsy at all like other tips ...
reviews.x: The tips are surprisingly very sturdy. They  aren't flimsy at all like other tips can be. The clear ones are very useful for doing any and every shape possible. Clear ones are also better if you're doing something other than French nails.

im glad these came in various sizes in individual bags that were labeled. After i found out what sizes fit each finger i laid it out in order and took a pic of the bags so i know without checking. They are also very clear!

Love these tips, wish I could buy individual sizes, wont be repurchasing because of this reason, doesnt make sence to buy 500 tips with a bunch of sizes I dont need😭😭 I even tried contacting the seller and got no where.

reviews.t: A true range in sizes and has a little extra ...
reviews.x: A true range in sizes and has a little extra on the sides making it easier to fit to the nail after a little bit of trimming if you want a fatter nail. Its the ones I use. And cheep, does not take to long to get here.

reviews.t: Horrible, cannot cut without the plastic turning white from ...
reviews.x: Horrible, cannot cut without the plastic turning white from pressure of nail clipper, they're also hard to file, and the curvature of the tip when gluing to the nail is not easy to work with.
Tips were thicker than my usual nail tips, but I had no issues applying or removing them. Although most sizes were not used, I was able to find a size to suit all ten of my fingernails.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tips sturdy, durable, and resistant to breaking, and praise the wide range of sizes that fit well.
A common complaint is that the tips are thin and develop hairline cracks or break easily, especially when cutting or shaping them.
Reviewers report the tips work well with dip powder and are easy to use, cut, and file.
Some reviewers note the tips are shorter than expected and that cutting them into a different shape can damage them.
Customer service is praised for quickly replacing a defective first pack with a better one.
